description: This PHP source file defines the ImpactDataApiController class within the Goteo project. The class manages API requests related to impact data, specifically providing a method for uploading images via AJAX. It extends an abstract API controller and integrates with Symfony's HTTP Foundation Request class.

classes.name: ImpactDataApiController
classes.description: Controller class handling impact data API endpoints, including image uploads, with permission checks.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to upload images for impact data categories; checks user permissions and returns JSON response.
